sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm at the ferry terminal with my ticket ready.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: My trip to the island starts with a change.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Excuse me, is the ten o'clock ferry still running?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sorry, that sailing's cancelled, but there's another one soon.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Oh, can I use this ticket for the next sailing?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, you don't need to buy a new ticket.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: That's good, because I've already paid for this one.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: The next sailing's at ten thirty from Pier Three, right?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's right, and there's still space for you today.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, I'd like to get on that ferry, please.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I stay at the desk to check the crossing.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: How long's the crossing from here to the island?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: It's about twenty-five minutes, so it won't take long.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I sit on the upper deck for the view?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sorry, the upper deck's closed, but we've got seats inside.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: That's fine, I'd rather stay warm on the crossing.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: No problem, you can take your small bag inside.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Should I keep my paper ticket in my hand?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, please have it ready when you get on.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Okay, I'll keep it somewhere safe until you need it.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Before I walk away, the same staff member adds something.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: You'll wait inside till ten twenty, then head out to Gate B.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, when should I head out to the gate?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Ten twenty, Gate B.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: So I'll wait inside first, then go to Gate B.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Exactly, it's just through those doors on your left.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Will someone check my ticket before I get on?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, I'll check it at the gate before boarding.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I'll follow the signs and keep my ticket ready.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: You're welcome, and I hope you enjoy the island.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I've got my next ferry sorted without buying another ticket.
